identificationModule.briefTitle: Denosumab (AMG 162) in Bisphosphonate Naive Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Active-controlled Study of AMG 162 in Breast Cancer Subjects With Bone Metastasis Who Have Not Previously Been Treated With Bisphosphonate Therapy.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is to evaluate various doses and schedules for denosumab administration and characterize the safety profile in this indication.

conditions: Bone Metastases in Subjects With Advanced Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Denosumab 60 mg every 12 weeks
armGroups.description: Denosumab 60 mg by subcutaneous injection once every 12 weeks (Q12W) for 25 weeks.

armGroups.label: Denosumab 120 mg every 4 weeks
armGroups.description: Denosumab 120 mg by subcutaneous injection once every 4 weeks (Q4W) for 25 weeks.

armGroups.label: Denosumab 180 mg every 4 weeks
armGroups.description: Denosumab 180 mg by subcutaneous injection once every 4 weeks (Q4W) for 25 weeks.

armGroups.label: IV bisphosphonates every 4 weeks
armGroups.description: Open label bisphosphonate every 4 weeks (Q4W) by intravenous infusion for 25 weeks.

armGroups.label: Denosumab 180 mg every 12 weeks
armGroups.description: Denosumab 180 mg by subcutaneous injection once every 12 weeks (Q12W) for 25 weeks.

armGroups.label: Denosumab 30 mg every 4 weeks
armGroups.description: Denosumab 30 mg by subcutaneous injection once every 4 weeks (Q4W) for 25 weeks.

interventions.name: IV Bisphosphonates
interventions.description: Commercially available intravenous (IV) bisphosphonates administered per package insert, included pamidronate, ibandronic acid, and zoledronic acid

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Creatinine-adjusted Urinary N-telopeptide (uNTx/Cr)
primaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in Urinary N-telopeptide corrected by creatinine (uNTx/Cr) calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value ) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in Urinary N-telopeptide (uNTx)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in Urinary N-telopeptide (uNTx) calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving 65% or More Reduction in Urinary N-telopeptide (uNTx) From Baseline at Week 13
secondaryOutcomes.description: The number of participants achieving a 65% reduction or more in uNTx from Baseline at Week 13. Calculation used is ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value ) x 100 and participants were considered having a 65% reduction or more if their value was ≤ -65%.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving 65% or More Reduction in uNTX From Baseline at Week 25
secondaryOutcomes.description: The number of participants achieving a 65% reduction or more in uNTX from Baseline at Week 25. Calculation used is ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100 and participants were considered having a 65% reduction or more if their value was ≤ -65%.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to 65% or More Reduction in Urinary N-telopeptide (uNTX) From Baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: Kaplan-Meier estimate of the median time from enrollment to the first occurrence of a reduction of uNTx of ≥ 65% compared to Baseline. For participants whose uNTx did not fall below 65% of the Baseline value, the time was censored at time of last evaluation of uNTx.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Serum C-Telopeptide (CTX)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in type I serum C-telopeptide (CTX) calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in Serum C-telopeptide (CTX)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in type I serum C-telopeptide calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Procollagen I N-terminal Peptide (P1NP)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in procollagen 1 N-terminal peptide calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in P1NP
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in procollagen 1 N-terminal peptide (P1NP) calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value ) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Tartrate-resistant Acid Phosphatase 5b (TRAP5b)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase 5b calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in Tartrate-resistant Acid Phosphatase 5b (TRAP5b)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in TRAP5b calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Bone Specific Alkaline Phosphatase (BSAP)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in bone specific alkaline phosphatase (BSAP) calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in Bone Specific Alkaline Phosphatase (BSAP)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in BSAP calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 13 in Osteocalcin
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 13 in osteocalcin calculated using ((Week 13 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value ) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 25 in Osteocalcin
secondaryOutcomes.description: Percent change from Baseline to Week 25 in osteocalcin calculated using ((Week 25 value - Baseline value) / Baseline value) x 100.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to First Skeletal Related Event
secondaryOutcomes.description: Skeletal Related Event (SRE) defined as ≥ 1 of the following: pathological bone fracture, spinal cord compression, surgery or radiation therapy to bone (including the use of radioisotopes).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Skeletal Related Events
secondaryOutcomes.description: Skeletal Related Events (SRE) are defined as ≥ 1 of the following: pathological bone fracture, spinal cord compression, surgery or radiation therapy to bone (including the use of radioisotopes).
Occurrence of grade 3 or 4 hypercalcemia according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) v3. A summary of hypercalcemia events is reported under adverse events.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria: - Histologically or cytologically confirmed breast adenocarcinoma

* At least one bone metastasis
